title: abbas aajao
body:
abbas aajao
aakhri salaam
maqtal me pahonche jab shaahe wala
laashe jawaan aur khaimon ko dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
darya ko dekha phir ye pukaara
ab ye salaame aakhir hai mera
abbas aajaawo bhaayi akela hai
tanha musaafir ko laakhon ne ghera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tumne na dekhi ghurbat hamaari
zainab thi laayi meri sawaari
rukhsat ka meri manzar ajab tha
sine se lag jaawo bhaayi akela hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jab se ho bichre abbas ham se
ehle haram hai lipte alam se
kaise jiyegi baali sakina
kya hoga batlaawo bhaayi akela hai
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkar kahaan ka jab tum nahi ho
aada to khush hain ab tum nahi ho
kitna akela kitna hun tanha
sine me hai ghaawo bhaayi akela hai
<<DIVIDER>>
din bhar uthaaye kitne janaaze
ab kaun hai jo dega dilaase
hote agar tum dete dilaasa
aaawo chale aaawo bhaayi akela hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mujh par baraste ye sang dekho
bekas ki tanha ki jang dekho
dekho na tute nana se waada
himmat barha jaawo bhaayi akela hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shimr khanjar ko pherta tha
qaatil ne shaah se khud ye sunaa tha
pyaasa gala us dam ye pukaara
surat dikha jaawo bhaayi akela hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sar sheh ka aaya noke sina par
aayi sada ye rehaan o sarwar
be sar parha hai bhaayi ka laasha
ab to chale aaawo bhaayi akela hai
